title: TaskMan of London
description: Book London furniture assembly, wall mounting, handyman, electrical, and smart home jobs.
summary: Book London furniture assembly, wall mounting, handyman, electrical, and smart home jobs.
offersHint: Book London furniture assembly, wall mounting, handyman, electrical, and smart home jobs. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://taskman.london/mcp

toolsPreview.name: find_services
toolsPreview.description: Use when the user needs help identifying which TaskMan of London service fits their job, especially for vague home-service requests in London.

toolsPreview.name: check_service_area
toolsPreview.description: Use when the user provides a London postcode or asks whether TaskMan covers their area.

toolsPreview.name: get_quote_estimate
toolsPreview.description: Use when the user asks about likely cost, ballpark pricing, or whether a task needs a custom quote.

toolsPreview.name: check_availability
toolsPreview.description: Use when the user asks about dates, timing, or whether a service can likely be booked soon.

toolsPreview.name: match_providers
toolsPreview.description: Use when an agent needs a single deterministic provider-matching result for assignment. Returns an ordered_candidates array sorted best-to-worst, where the first can_assign=true candidate is the assignee.

toolsPreview.name: create_booking_request
toolsPreview.description: Use when the user is ready to submit details for a real TaskMan of London booking request.

toolsPreview.name: get_booking_status
toolsPreview.description: Use when the user already has a TaskMan booking request and wants an update.

toolsPreview.name: start_trusted_phone_session
toolsPreview.description: Use in trusted telephony flows when the caller number is already verified by the channel provider and you need a short-lived booking session without OTP.

toolsPreview.name: start_customer_verification
toolsPreview.description: Use when an existing customer wants to verify identity (OTP or magic link) before assistant-led booking.

toolsPreview.name: verify_customer_otp
toolsPreview.description: Use after sending an OTP challenge, to verify the one-time passcode and open a short-lived booking session.

toolsPreview.name: verify_magic_link_token
toolsPreview.description: Use when the customer clicks a magic link and provides the token for verification.

toolsPreview.name: get_customer_profile
toolsPreview.description: Use after verification to load scoped customer profile details from CRM for booking.

toolsPreview.name: list_customer_addresses
toolsPreview.description: Use after verification to list saved addresses linked to the verified customer.

toolsPreview.name: list_service_types
toolsPreview.description: Use after verification to show supported service types before collecting booking details.

toolsPreview.name: get_customer_availability
toolsPreview.description: Use after verification to check availability for a verified customer at a selected saved address.

toolsPreview.name: start_booking_payment
toolsPreview.description: Use after collecting booking details to create a Stripe checkout payment session before final booking submission.

toolsPreview.name: get_booking_payment_status
toolsPreview.description: Use to check whether a booking payment session is pending, paid, failed, canceled, or expired before attempting booking creation.

toolsPreview.name: create_customer_booking
toolsPreview.description: Use after verification, detail collection, and confirmed paid payment session to create a booking scoped to the verified customer.

toolsPreview.name: update_contact_note
toolsPreview.description: Use to append an internal CRM note for the verified customer during or after booking.

toolsPreview.name: tag_contact
toolsPreview.description: Use to add CRM tags to the verified customer for booking workflow tracking.
